tips.name: Defense-Based Block Rate Boost
tips.body:
Increases Block Rate by 3% for every 150 Defense.

Targets under Protection cannot receive Link effects.

tips.body: Removes debuffs in the order they were applied.

builds.name: Maximum Defense
builds.gear_notes: This build serves to push Giyu's Defense to the highest possible to not only allow him to get the maximum amount of Block Rate passively (33%) but also to take as little damage as possible.

builds.name: Defensive Longevity
builds.gear_notes: An alternative build to give Giyu more HP to outlive his foes with his tanky teammates to support him and keep his HP well and high.

builds.name: All-Out DPS
builds.gear_notes: A DPS build to capitalize on his passive 100% Weakness Hit Chance on his skills to better deal with casual PVE enemies.

dedicated.name: Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka's Nichirin Sword

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Giyu Tomioka survive Critical Hits more easily.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Giyu Tomioka by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story: A blue-hued blade wielded with refined technique. The hilt features the same tortoise shell pattern as his haori.

lore:
Giyu is a calm and composed swordsman who carries out his duties with unwavering precision as the Demon Slayer Corps' Water Hashira.

He quietly assesses the situation with cool judgment before dispatching demons through clean, efficient swordsmanship. Shortly after becoming a Hashira, he encountered the Kamado siblings and sent them to his former mentor. Although naturally reserved, he once showed rare anger in order to encourage Tanjiro after he lost his family.
